complete_examples.text: With consideration of the system property evolution, it is anticipated that train–track interaction is both a random process and possessing abundant random information.
Using time–frequency transformation method [3], time-domain track irregularities, loaded as an input of train–track interaction, can be equivalently obtained from the PSD function.
Train–track interaction is essentially randomness propagation processes due to the spatial variation and temporal degradation of system excitations [1].
In this work, a train–track interaction model compiled by a train, ballasted track, and a robust wheel–rail contact model is presented.
The current work involving matrix reas-sembly to minimize the bandwidth is rarely reported in the establishment of train–track interaction model in matrix formulations.
